watch_indicators: new OFAC vessel or entity designation
new EU or UK OFSI shipping-related listing
Hormuz or Bab-el-Mandeb security incident or transit advisory
Red Sea attack or rerouting notice
P&I club withdrawal or cover-confirmation change
AIS gap, spoofing, or dark-activity report on the vessel
price-cap attestation refusal, withdrawal, or itemized ancillary-cost gap
boundary: This taxonomy supports pre-compliance evidence triage of maritime sanctions and chokepoint-disruption exposure for vessels and voyages transiting the Strait of Hormuz, Persian/Arabian Gulf, Gulf of Oman, Bab-el-Mandeb, or Red Sea. It does not resolve vessel ownership, verify identity, or provide legal, sanctions, compliance, financial, investment, insurance, or trading advice.
